children: JOST raised FY2026 sales growth guidance to 9%–11% from a single-digit increase and adjusted EBIT growth guidance to 11%–14% from mid- to high-single digits. Preliminary, unaudited Q3 sales rose 11.3% to €426.3M and adjusted EBIT rose 11.8% to €41.6M year over year.
Raised from a single-digit increase; the upgrade signals stronger expected full-year growth.
Raised from mid- to high-single-digit growth, despite expected Q4 input-cost increases.
Preliminary, unaudited results show growth across all regions and business lines, with no acquisition effects.
Profit growth exceeded sales growth; figures are preliminary and unaudited.
The range compares with 9.5% in 2025 and reflects expected cost synergies partly offsetting higher input costs.

This is an upgraded outlook supported by preliminary Q3 growth and further Hyva cross-selling synergies. The final Q3 results, due November 12, 2026, will show whether performance supports the raised forecast amid Q4 cost pressures.
Based on the original press release from JOST Werke SE distributed by EQS.
